run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-17T10:11:12Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: Frontend's elevated error rate is real and began at the alert's start: its span-error signal was 0 through the 10:10:12Z evaluation and nonzero from 10:11:12Z, and every frontend ERROR span in the window belongs to the ad call path (grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, tcp.connect, GET /api/data and its API-route span). The ad backend is gone: ad Deployment has 1 desired replica but no ready/available replicas, ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 has 0 replicas, and the ad Service has no endpoints. Its pod ad-554b849958-p226w was stopped at 10:10:10Z and the ReplicaSet could not create a replacement because a ResourceQuota, otel-demo-memory, was created at 10:10:00Z and rejects the 225Mi ad pod; the exact event message is 'pods "ad-554b849958-v9dqt" is forbidden: exceeded quota: otel-demo-memory, requested: memory=225Mi, used: memory=1901Mi, limited: memory=1503238553600m', and the quota's used 1901Mi already exceeds its hard value (~1.43GiB) before ad is added. So the fault originates in ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory in otel-demo. The ad deployment's 1->0->1 replica cycle at 10:10:10-10:10:20Z (same ReplicaSet, no new template revision) is the mechanism that exposed it; what performed that scale-down and created the quota is not visible without change history. The frontend pod itself is running with 0 restarts, and fault-injection flags in flagd-config are all off.

claims.text: frontend's ERROR span count was zero through the 10:10:12Z evaluation and nonzero from 10:11:12Z onward (increase over 300s: 150 at 10:11:12Z, peak 1322 at 10:17:12Z, still 355 at 10:23:12Z); the 1h increase series first becomes nonzero at 10:11:12Z. This matches the alert's stated start of 2026-11-17T10:11:12Z.

frontend's ERROR spans are confined to ad-dependent operations: GET, GET /api/data, executing api route (pages) /api/data, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds and tcp.connect. Its cart, checkout and other gRPC client span names show 0 error increase in the same query.

The ad Service (selector opentelemetry.io/name=ad, port 8080) has no endpoints, Deployment ad has 1 desired replica but no ready or available replicas, and ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 (owned by Deployment ad, replica count 0) has status.replicas 0.

Events in otel-demo: Pod ad-554b849958-p226w 'Killing' (Normal) at 10:10:10Z; Deployment ad 'Scaled down replica set ad-554b849958 from 1 to 0' at 10:10:10Z and 'Scaled up replica set ad-554b849958 from 0 to 1' at 10:10:20Z; ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 then emitted 10 FailedCreate warnings at 10:10:20-10:10:21Z plus a combined count-8 warning at 10:15:48Z.

The exact FailedCreate message names the quota as the cause: pods "ad-554b849958-v9dqt" is forbidden: exceeded quota: otel-demo-memory, requested: memory=225Mi, used: memory=1901Mi, limited: memory=1503238553600m. The same message appears on Deployment ad's ReplicaFailure condition (True, reason FailedCreate) while its Available condition is False with reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable since 10:10:20Z.

ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory in namespace otel-demo has creationTimestamp 2026-11-17T10:10:00Z, hard memory 1503238553600m (about 1433.6MiB) and status.used memory 1901Mi; used therefore already exceeded hard before the 225Mi ad pod was requested. It is the only ResourceQuota in the cluster.
The 20 pods currently running in otel-demo list memory requests that sum to 1901Mi, which equals the quota's used value, and the ad container requests memory 225Mi with limit 450Mi.

ad's own span volume declines after the incident: the 1200s increase for oteldemo.AdService/GetAds falls from 1145.6 at 10:11:12Z to 285.4 at 10:26:12Z, with getAdsByCategory and getRandomAds following the same decline.

frontend-proxy has its own ERROR spans on operations ingress and router frontend egress, first elevated in the 10:12:00Z evaluation (36.7 over 300s) and continuing (263.3 at 10:17:12Z); these are the proxy hops serving frontend requests.

The flagd-config ConfigMap's demo.flagd.json lists fault flags adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure and recommendationCacheFailure, all with state ENABLED and defaultVariant 'off'.

Sampled frontend and frontend-proxy spans from about 10:09:26-10:09:28Z, before the error onset, carry http.status_code 200 (e.g. GET, GET /api/cart, POST /api/cart, executing api route (pages) /api/cart) and rpc.grpc.status_code 0 on grpc client spans.
Pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-nkn95 is Running, ready, with restartCount 0, and Deployment frontend reports 1 desired, 1 ready and 1 available replica.

The only metric names returned for service_name=frontend in this Prometheus are traces_span_metrics_calls_total and traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket; no http_server request metric series was returned for frontend, so the alert's 5.0889 figure cannot be reproduced from an HTTP request metric here.

The span-level error fraction for frontend over a 5m window at 10:23:12Z was 0.0725 (7.25%) computed from traces_span_metrics_calls_total; this is a ratio of spans, not of unique requests, and it does not equal the alert annotation value 5.088888888888889.

Causal chain: ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory (created 10:10:00Z, hard memory below the namespace's already-used 1901Mi) rejected creation of the replacement ad pod after ad-554b849958-p226w was stopped at 10:10:10Z; ad therefore has no available replicas and no Service endpoints, frontend's AdService/GetAds calls fail (ERROR spans on grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, tcp.connect, GET /api/data), and that ad-path failure is what raised frontend's error rate and fired RequestErrorRate.

The ad pod removal at 10:10:10Z was a replica-cycle/restart, not a template rollout: the same ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 was scaled 1->0 and back to 1, the Deployment is at revision 1, and the pod template image digest is unchanged. It occurred 10 seconds after ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory was created at 10:10:00Z, which suggests one change action created the quota and cycled the ad Deployment, but that link is not proven.

Fault injection through flagd was considered as the trigger for frontend's ad errors. The fallback flagd-config lists adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc and other failure flags, but every one has defaultVariant 'off', so the component is configured not to inject these faults.

A frontend application defect or a failure of frontend's other dependencies was considered. frontend's ERROR spans are confined to the ad call path with zero error-span increase for its CartService/GetCart, CartService/AddItem, CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and /api/cart or /api/checkout route spans, and the frontend pod has restartCount 0, so this is not supported by the evidence.

ad did not report a burst of its own application errors: the only ad ERROR span series in the window is flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream at a steady ~1.02-1.05 per 1200s from 09:52 onward, i.e. already present before the incident, while ad's request-serving spans stopped growing. The observed failure is the absence of a reachable ad endpoint, not ad returning errors.

The failure is not a namespace-wide pod outage: apart from ad, every otel-demo Deployment reports 1 desired with 1 ready and 1 available replica, and the pods table lists restartCount 0 for all 20 running pods.

Raise or remove the memory hard limit on ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory so it covers the namespace's existing 1901Mi of requests plus the 225Mi ad pod (or revert the quota to its prior value), so ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 can admit a pod and ad regains an endpoint.

Identify the actor that created ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory at 10:10:00Z and that scaled Deployment ad down and up at 10:10:10-10:10:20Z, and review that change before it is repeated for other workloads whose pods cannot currently be admitted either.

After ad has a Ready pod, verify recovery by checking that the ad Service has endpoints and that frontend's grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, tcp.connect and GET /api/data ERROR span activity returns to zero, which is what should clear RequestErrorRate.

gaps: The change_history integration is not available, so who or what created ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory at 2026-11-17T10:10:00Z, and what scaled Deployment ad 1->0->1 at 10:10:10-10:10:20Z, cannot be identified.

Jaeger's newest returned traces end at about 10:09:28Z, before the error onset, so no failing trace's status tags or error details for the ad calls could be read; the error evidence is the aggregated traces_span_metrics_calls_total series.
fetch_pod_logs for frontend-675fd7b5c5-nkn95 returned no lines with or without an error filter, so frontend's application error text is unverified.
Pod ad-554b849958-p226w no longer exists, so its termination reason, exit code, logs and any events beyond the Normal 'Killing' event are unknown.

The alerting rule RequestErrorRate returned no matching rule from Prometheus, and no HTTP server or rpc client metric series exist for service_name=frontend in this target, so the alert expression and its current value 5.088888888888889 could not be reproduced.
Whether the quota's hard value 1503238553600m was set at creation or edited afterwards, and the earlier replica history of Deployment ad, cannot be observed from current object state.

Services without any returned ERROR series in the error-by-service query (e.g. cart, product-catalog, checkout, currency, email, shipping) are unknown rather than proven error-free for their own server-side telemetry, because a missing series is not zero.
next_steps: Review the change record or audit log for the creation of ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory at 10:10:00Z and the Deployment ad replica cycle at 10:10:10-10:10:20Z on 2026-11-17.

Right-size the memory hard limit on ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory to at least the namespace's 1901Mi existing requests plus the 225Mi ad pod, or remove/revert the quota, then confirm the ad ReplicaSet creates a Ready pod.
Check whether other workloads in otel-demo can still be rescheduled while used memory (1901Mi) exceeds the quota hard limit (1503238553600m).
After ad recovers, confirm the ad Service has endpoints and frontend's ad-path ERROR span activity stops, then confirm RequestErrorRate clears.
